name: xemphim-microservices
description: XEMPHIM Movie Booking System - Microservices Monorepo

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix services/user-service && npm install --prefix services/movie-service && npm install --prefix services/seat-service && npm install --prefix services/booking-service && npm install --prefix services/payment-service && npm install --prefix services/notification-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev-services: concurrently "npm run dev-user" "npm run dev-movie" "npm run dev-seat" "npm run dev-booking" "npm run dev-payment" "npm run dev-notification"
scripts.dev-all: concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev-gateway" "npm run dev-user" "npm run dev-movie" "npm run dev-seat" "npm run dev-booking" "npm run dev-payment" "npm run dev-notification" "npm run dev-frontend"
